table_title: Water levels, in feet above sea-level datum of 1929, in 1930-34 and 1941
site_name: City of Santa Barbara, well 119-A. War Department, Camp Cooke Military Reservation.
location_text: About 4.5 miles northwest of Lompoc, about 500 feet north of intersection of Casmalia Road and Pine Canyon Road, 15 feet west of Casmalia Road, beneath frame windmill tower.
quantities_units: water level (feet above sea-level datum of 1929)
notes: Measurements Oct. 28, 1930 to Mar. 25, 1934, then Apr. 24 to Nov. 12, 1941; none 1935-40. The state is not printed on this page (running head: CARPINTERIA, GOLETA, AND SANTA YNEZ VALLEYS); earlier pages were not opened for it. The well number carries no N/S or E/W letters as printed. Owner line names both City of Santa Barbara (well 119-A) and War Department.
